# Preface {.unnumbered}

*Draft placeholder.*

This book accompanies Econ/Demog C175. Each chapter takes up one topic from
the course's lectures; the parts group related topics, and the optional chapters
at the end cover topics taught in earlier years. It explains the economic model behind that week's lectures in plain
language, reads the classic texts alongside you, and shows how the model can be
confronted with data. The labs are where you do that confrontation yourself. The
book is meant to prepare you for them, not to do them for you.

How to use each chapter:

- **Before lecture**, read the opening sections and the "In their own words"
  boxes, which quote the assigned classic reading.
- **After lecture**, work through the model sections and the "Check your
  understanding" questions.
- **Before the lab**, read the "Data in action" section. It uses the same data
  you will use, but leaves the lab's questions for you.

The R code that makes each figure is folded away under "Show the R code." You
don't need it to follow the text, but it is there if you're curious how a figure
was made.
